title: 6-month gate: AtlasAI beta, interview-ready v1, applications begin
objective: Ship AtlasAI as a production beta with a public eval report and benchmark. Finalize resume v1, LinkedIn, GitHub, 2-minute intro. Ten design diagrams. Phase 3 assessment. Start targeted applications.
topics: AtlasAI: README → diagram → API spec → tests → CI → deploy → metrics → benchmark → failure analysis → demo
Resume v1 (one page, artifact-led), LinkedIn, pinned repos, 2-min intro
theory: Google 6-month gate: solve common mediums without hand-holding; discuss your systems deeply.
deliverables: resume-v1.pdf; LinkedIn featured demos; 2-min intro recorded
Application tracker with first 10 rows + 2 referral conversations logged

knowledge: Which P3 questions did you miss?
What is AtlasAI’s p95 and cost/answer?
practical: Phase 3 gate pass criteria all met; applications sent

tasks.text: DSA · Intervals: Meeting Rooms II (Medium, B75) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.

AtlasAI README: problem → architecture diagram → API spec → run locally → tests/CI → deploy → metrics → benchmark table (p50/p95, throughput, cost/answer) → failure analysis → limitations. Tag v0.9-beta. Public URL with a demo tenant.
Record a 5-minute demo (question → cited answer → source preview → refusal on a trap → Langfuse trace → eval CI). Link in README.
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “AtlasAI README: problem → architecture diagram → API spec → run locally → tests/CI → deplo” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.

DSA · Intervals: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query (Hard) — 25-min honest attempt each, then the NeetCode video; write pattern + time/space complexity in your solutions repo; log gap type in mistakes.md.

Resume v1: one page; top third = “Full-stack engineer (X yrs) building LLM & real-time systems”; projects with metrics + links (PairCraft, AtlasAI, Voice→Notes, gateway); experience compressed to impact bullets. One variant for SWE, one for AI Engineer.
LinkedIn: headline with searchable terms, featured = two live demos, open-to-work titles. GitHub: pin the 3 flagships/minis with best READMEs; unpin the rest.
Quiet Network: 1–2 genuine conversations with engineers from your target list (thoughtful comment or a question about their work; no pitch, no referral ask). Log in the tracker.
Bring designs/ to 10 diagrams: add pastebin, typeahead, file storage, job scheduler, payment workflow (45-min runs → reference → delta) — or complete the ones you skipped.
2-minute intro: write, record, cut until tight. Career-switch story framed as deliberate compounding.
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “Bring designs/ to 10 diagrams: add pastebin, typeahead, file storage, job scheduler, payme” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.
Timed set: 2 unseen mediums (DP/greedy/intervals) in 45 min narrating. Then re-solve 6 flagged D3 problems cold.
Read 2 live Google SWE JDs + 3 adjacent-company JDs; map each minimum qualification to evidence in your resume (notes/targets.md).
Quiet Network: 1–2 genuine conversations with engineers from your target list (thoughtful comment or a question about their work; no pitch, no referral ask). Log in the tracker.
Take the 6-month gate (Assessments → P3): knowledge, coding, practical (AtlasAI from a fresh browser; gateway table; 10 diagrams; resume), explanation. Record.

Apply: Google SWE (referral if a Quiet Network conversation is ready; else direct with JD-tailored bullets) + 5 adjacent companies. Tracker: company · role · level · JD id · matching evidence · resume version · referral · date · status · next action.
Gate outcome: tick m-rag (and m-sd items that hold); subscribe to Latent Space (1 of max 2 newsletters); write the phase review.

Weekly revision — AtlasAI: README → diagram → API spec → tests → CI → deploy → metrics → benchmark → failure analysis → demo, Resume v1 (one page, artifact-led), LinkedIn, pinned repos, 2-min intro, 10 system-design diagrams, Phase 3 assessment (6-month gate): rewrite the key ideas from memory (no notes), then compare with your notes and fix the gaps. Reimplement two things from this week without looking.
DSA spaced re-solve (from W23): Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix (Hard, B75) · Distinct Subsequences (Hard) — cold, ≤30 min each, narrate.
Weekly review: answer this week’s knowledge questions aloud, run the practical checks, then write the three notes (struggled / learned / improve) in Weekly Plan → Review. Update the tracking sheet.

JS/MERN spaced recall (Cycle 1 · explain + implement) · Browser platform & full-stack auth flow: Explain event delegation, CORS preflight, cookies vs localStorage; draw the end-to-end JWT/cookie auth flow from memory. Log misses in mistakes.md; if you fail the check, redo the matching module in Side Tracks → 🟨 JavaScript & MERN Refresher.
Plan next week: read W27’s objective and Day 1; move any unfinished 🔴 task into next week’s Day 1; confirm calendar blocks. Then rest — consistency beats intensity.
